title: The activation energy on the energy distribution
caption: Only collisions with at least the activation energy Ea lead to reaction. The shaded area beyond Ea is the fraction of molecules energetic enough to react: a small part of the whole.
alt: Maxwell–Boltzmann distribution of molecular energies starting at zero, rising to a peak and falling slowly; the tail beyond Ea is shaded.
description: The curve starts at the origin: no molecules have zero energy.
It peaks at the most probable energy and tails off; it never quite reaches the axis.
Beyond Ea (shaded): the molecules that can react.

checks.name: the area under the curve is all the molecules (normalised to 1)
the most probable energy is ½kT
